declared_purpose: Manage n8n workflows through creation, activation, validation/testing, execution monitoring, debugging and performance analysis. The entry document explicitly requires N8N_API_KEY/N8N_BASE_URL and complete functional workflows; credential persistence, retrieval limits and reporting formats are implementation choices (SKILL.md:2-19,37-72).

data_operations.condition: User follows the setup instructions. The scripts do not implement this settings-file write or read.

data_operations.operation: Read connection configuration and transmit authentication
data_operations.source: N8nClient constructor arguments or environment variables
data_operations.data_scope: N8N_BASE_URL and N8N_API_KEY; the key becomes the X-N8N-API-KEY header
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Client/session memory, then the configured N8N_BASE_URL/api/v1 endpoint
data_operations.condition: Client construction reads configuration; each API request sends the configured headers. No broader environment collection is shown.

data_operations.operation: Read explicitly selected local JSON files
data_operations.source: Workflow files, templates/<selected-name>.json, test-data files and test-suite files
data_operations.data_scope: Complete JSON contents of the selected file
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Local process memory; subsequent disclosure depends on the selected action
data_operations.condition: Corresponding file/template option is supplied. Test-data and suite reads can occur before the tester's missing-client failure.

data_operations.data_scope: Unprojected workflow/execution list or detail responses; requests include identifiers, optional active/workflow filters and execution limits
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: N8nClient memory and its caller; API CLI returns results through stdout
data_operations.condition: Corresponding list/detail method or command is invoked. Execution listing defaults to 20 records.

data_operations.operation: Request workflow creation, modification or activation changes
data_operations.source: Caller-supplied workflow dictionary or loaded workflow/template JSON
data_operations.data_scope: Creation sends all supplied fields except active and id; update sends the supplied dictionary; activation sends an active boolean
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Configured n8n workflow endpoints; remote workflow persistence or modification is requested
data_operations.condition: Corresponding method or supported CLI command is invoked. Server storage details are unspecified.

data_operations.source: Loaded JSON or workflow retrieved from n8n
data_operations.data_scope: Node names/types, connections, credential presence, URLs, webhook paths and email configuration; derived validation errors and warnings
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Validator memory, caller and selected CLI report/stdout
data_operations.condition: Validation is requested. WorkflowTester file validation needs no client; ID validation retrieves the workflow. The API CLI constructs its authenticated client even for file validation.

data_operations.source: Caller/CLI execution data or loaded test data
data_operations.data_scope: Workflow ID and nonempty supplied data; the API dry-run helper also returns the test input to its caller
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Configured n8n POST /workflows/{id}/execute endpoint; downstream execution effects remain workflow-dependent
data_operations.condition: API execute and N8nClient.dry_run_workflow send ordinary execution requests. WorkflowTester.dry_run requires an injected or previously initialized client. No separate simulation flag or temporary-execution cleanup is shown.

data_operations.operation: Poll execution details and return test results
data_operations.data_scope: Execution ID, completion/error state, timestamps, mode and complete returned execution data
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: WorkflowTester memory and caller; selected CLI paths print results
data_operations.condition: A working tester client submits an execution and receives an execution ID. Polling makes up to 30 detail requests at two-second intervals. Timeout returns an ID without cancelling or deleting the execution.

data_operations.source: Caller-supplied test cases and dry-run results
data_operations.data_scope: Test names, input, expected output and actual execution results; expected output is retained but pass/fail checks only execution status
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Returned test-suite dictionary; CLI stdout if the suite completes
data_operations.condition: Each nonempty suite requires a working tester client. No separate external recipient or persistent test-results store is implemented.

data_operations.operation: Retrieve execution history and derive statistics
data_operations.source: Configured n8n execution listing, filtered by workflow ID with limit 100
data_operations.data_scope: Execution records, error-message frequencies, start/stop pairs and counts; success is inferred from finished rather than execution status
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Local statistics dictionary and caller; stats CLI stdout
data_operations.condition: Statistics are requested directly or through the optimizer. The days argument is unused. Aggregation requires iterable execution dictionaries and fails for the documented response envelope.

data_operations.operation: Infer workflow performance attributes and render recommendations
data_operations.source: Retrieved workflow definition and derived execution statistics
data_operations.data_scope: Workflow ID/name, node names/types, graph complexity, expensive-operation labels, health category, bottlenecks and performance score
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Local analysis/report, caller and optimizer CLI stdout
data_operations.condition: Optimizer analyze, suggest or report succeeds. Suggestions are returned as text/data; the optimizer does not apply caching, retention or workflow changes.

data_operations.operation: Run the separate API-client structural analysis
data_operations.source: Workflow definition and up to 10 execution records from n8n
data_operations.data_scope: Graph/node information; execution-response truthiness controls a retention recommendation
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Local analysis dictionary returned to the Python caller
data_operations.condition: N8nClient.analyze_workflow_performance is called. It recommends retention and HTTP-response caching but implements neither persistence action.
Python delete_workflow or delete_execution is explicitly invoked. These methods are absent from CLI action choices; test paths do not invoke them. Physical erasure is unknown.

data_operations.operation: Expose API errors through local exceptions and CLI output
data_operations.source: n8n HTTP error responses and caught exceptions
data_operations.data_scope: HTTP status and complete response.text; polling can also print caught exception text
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Calling Python code, CLI stderr, or tester polling stdout
data_operations.condition: An HTTP request or command fails. Any further logging or collection by the calling environment is unspecified.

data_operations.source: Created-workflow response and rendered optimization report
data_operations.data_scope: Returned workflow JSON; workflow name, metrics and recommendations in the report
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: workflow.json and optimization-report.txt in the shell's working directory
data_operations.condition: User follows README commands containing output redirection. Ordinary script returns/stdout do not themselves establish file persistence.

potential_excess.data_scope: N8N_API_KEY retained as a JSON configuration value
potential_excess.condition: User chooses the documented persistent settings option
potential_excess.purpose_basis: Authentication requires access to the key during execution; persistent plaintext configuration is an optional setup choice.
potential_excess.necessary_behavior: Provide N8N_API_KEY to the client for authenticated requests.
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: Use the documented session environment option or secure-manager injection instead of retaining the key in this settings entry.
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: The launch environment must still supply the key. This concerns documented storage, not an automatic script write.

potential_excess.data_scope: Execution records outside the requested days interval
potential_excess.recipient_or_storage: Configured n8n API to N8nClient memory; subsequently statistics/optimizer results
potential_excess.condition: The limit-100 response contains older records. The request and aggregation do not use days.
potential_excess.purpose_basis: Statistics and optimizer commands present a requested analysis period; the optimizer labels its result with that period.
potential_excess.necessary_behavior: Obtain sufficient records to calculate the requested interval's metrics.
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: Enforce the interval before aggregation and output; use server-side time filtering if supported. Otherwise disclose the retrieval limitation and avoid claiming interval-specific results.
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Retain required in-window records and diagnostics. API support for remote time filtering is unknown. This is extra data in a needed history request, not a separate disclosure action.

potential_excess.data_scope: Raw error-message frequency keys and per-execution start/stop pairs constructed for optimizer calls
potential_excess.recipient_or_storage: Local get_workflow_statistics dictionary passed to WorkflowOptimizer
potential_excess.condition: Statistics aggregation succeeds during optimizer analysis
potential_excess.purpose_basis: The implemented optimizer uses execution counts and success rate, not error_patterns or execution_times.
potential_excess.necessary_behavior: Compute counts/rates and inspect workflow structure for the existing optimizer output.
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: Provide an optimizer-specific summary mode that skips these unused diagnostic collections; preserve detailed statistics for callers requesting them.
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Keep existing optimizer scores, health labels and recommendations. This reduces local processing/materialization within a required request; it does not establish reduced network retrieval.

potential_excess.data_scope: Up to 10 execution records used only to decide whether to emit a generic retention suggestion
potential_excess.recipient_or_storage: Extra GET /executions request to configured n8n; returned history enters N8nClient memory
potential_excess.purpose_basis: Structural analysis uses the workflow graph; execution history is consulted only through response truthiness.
potential_excess.necessary_behavior: Analyze structure; preserving the conditional suggestion requires only knowing whether executions exist.
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: Omit this history action for structure-only analysis or reuse a known execution count. If the conditional suggestion is retained, request at most one record and interpret the response envelope correctly.
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Preserve graph analysis and, where required, the actual execution-existence condition. The action is redundant for graph analysis; fetching 10 records is additionally overbroad for an existence check.

unknowns: Partial scope: README.md:81-90 and 280-296 advertise templates and fixtures absent from the supplied inventory. Their payloads, implemented recipients and persistence cannot be audited; template creation fails when the selected file is absent (scripts/n8n_api.py:300-307).

Actual workflow definitions and execution inputs are not supplied. Downstream API calls, emails, database writes, disclosure scopes and test side effects remain unresolved; the test helpers submit ordinary execution requests (scripts/n8n_api.py:98-103,171-179; scripts/n8n_tester.py:193-204).

The tester CLI constructs WorkflowTester without a client, while dry_run dereferences self.client without initializing it. Ordinary CLI dry-run and nonempty test-suite paths therefore fail before remote execution; prior ID validation or client injection enables the Python paths. The --report validation occurs too late to initialize that execution path (scripts/n8n_tester.py:24-32,203-204,360-400).

references/api.md:77-92 documents an execution-list response envelope, but the client returns it unchanged and statistics iterate it as execution dictionaries. With that documented response, aggregation fails, leaving optimizer statistics, scores and reports unresolved (scripts/n8n_api.py:33-40,82-87,182-216).

The actual N8N_BASE_URL, transport, server access controls, response contents, execution retention, logs and physical deletion behavior are unspecified. Requests and deletion calls do not establish external storage or erasure guarantees.
